question: In a certain code language. 'AJDM' is written as 'JDMA'. How will 'SKWM' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘AJDM' is written as 'JDMA’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d9e86b60c0529a93207129e33adf639fdd925c3da0e66167cbac2f2f03b0605.png] 

Similarly, for '**SKWM**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64a26c32a699d9e7fcccbca521e46f9e92e7cde64e4d3457083dfb0b92bb2202.png] 

So, 'SKWM' will be written as '**KWMS**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
